preconditions.description: The number of characters n must be between 3 and 100,000.
The number of known relationships m must be between 0 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b, c in relationships)
preconditions.description: All character indices in the relationships must be valid and distinct.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {0, 1} for a, b, c in relationships)
preconditions.description: Each relationship must be either love (1) or hate (0).

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of valid configurations modulo 1,000,000,007.
